scope: DE-1 repo review register; read-only evidence. No workflow, site, pricing or shared dataset was edited.
method: Each item lists the measured value, how it was measured (command or fetch), and the source link. Items marked 'unverified' were not confirmed.

items.finding: README test counts are stale. README says 76 Python regression tests and 27 Playwright checks.
items.measured: python -m unittest discover -s tests (requirements.txt installed, Python 3.11.2): Ran 100 tests, OK. npx playwright test --list: Total: 32 tests in 2 files.

items.finding: COORDINATION.md I-16 'Refresh not scheduled' is still marked needs review, but pages.yml now has a four-hour cron.
items.measured: pages.yml line 6: cron '17 */4 * * *'. Scheduled runs exist (see DE-3).
items.action: Close or update I-16 on the board.

items.finding: Lock time mismatch. Hotspawn's official help page says picks lock 5 minutes before start. The fixture data locks 6 minutes before start, and the site uses the per-fixture value.
items.measured: Start minus lock_time = 360 s for 80 of 80 saved fixture records. lock_offset_sec = 360 for all 80. Help page says 'Picks lock 5 minutes before the scheduled start time' and its recorded lock_minutes = 5.
items.action: Treat the earlier lock as the safe deadline (submit at least 6 minutes before start). Owner of the site should show both values and flag the difference.

items.finding: Hotspawn lobby headline disagrees with its own filter counts.
items.measured: Header: '72 matches this week'. Tier 'All tiers (78)'. Tournament filter counts sum to 78.
items.action: Flag only. The site does not use the header number.

items.finding: Stored inventory has 80 records; lobby filters total 78. The difference is exactly two matches that had started before the lobby read: 1080279 (WROTBERRY vs EAC, 08:00Z) and 1080201 (Aurora vs Ninjas in Pyjamas, 08:30Z). These account for the Elisa (12 vs 11) and Thunderpick WC (4 vs 3) count differences.
items.measured: reconcile_lobby.py: 17 of 17 lobby upcoming entries match stored fixtures by ID, competition and start minute. Tournament count differences: only Elisa BreakOut Series #2 and Thunderpick World Championship 2026.

items.finding: The fixture feed only returns currently scheduled fixtures. Matches that finish drop out, so the inventory cannot contain results. 9z vs Aurora (14 Oct 2026) is not in the inventory.
items.measured: status=scheduled returns the fixture list. status=finished returns an empty array ([]). The feed has no finished-match records to reconcile.
items.action: Day-one results must come from a results source such as HLTV, not from Hotspawn. Said plainly on the review page.

items.finding: The fixture API is hosted on a third-party cloud subdomain (phpstack-1372681-6459848.cloudwaysapps.com), not a Hotspawn domain. No public Hotspawn API documentation was located. The README says 'Every row links an official Hotspawn source', and that label covers this API link.
items.measured: Host: phpstack-1372681-6459848.cloudwaysapps.com. The lobby's own team images are served from the same host.
items.action: Label the API as Hotspawn's client endpoint, not an official documented API.

items.finding: Scheduled refreshes are irregular. Four of six four-hourly slots had a scheduled run within 2 hours. The 16:17 UTC slot on 14 Oct and the 08:17 UTC slot on 15 Oct had none. No scheduled run has been recorded since 04:39 UTC.
items.measured: Scheduled runs at 13:43, 20:12, 23:14 (14 Oct) and 04:39 (15 Oct) UTC. Largest completed gap 6.48 h. At audit time (10:09Z) 5.51 h since the last scheduled run. The first scheduled run was 14 Oct 13:43 UTC.
items.action: Owner of pages.yml to add redundancy (see R-DE-3 in COORDINATION.md). Not changed in this session.

items.finding: GitHub documents that scheduled runs can be delayed under load and that some queued jobs may be dropped. In a public repository, scheduled workflows are disabled after 60 days without repository activity. This repository is public.
items.action: Keep repository activity regular. Monitor the scheduled run count.

items.finding: Two Pages runs failed on push. Both were followed by successful deploys.
items.measured: Run 38517464314 (14 Oct 05:35Z) failed; later run 38518319041 succeeded. Run 38707237342 (15 Oct 08:39Z) failed; later run 38707602980 succeeded.

items.finding: Thunderpick odds come from an undocumented POST endpoint (/api/matches with gameIds 6). No official Thunderpick API documentation was located in this audit. Third-party odds aggregators exist but require their own API keys, which this project does not have.
items.measured: Web search for Thunderpick API documentation returned only third-party aggregator pages (odds-api.io and esportsodds.gg). No Thunderpick developer page was found.
items.action: Label as an unofficial endpoint. Keep the single-source limitation visible.

items.finding: Valve regional standings repository exists, is not archived, and was last pushed on 5 Oct 2026. GitHub reports no license.
items.measured: GitHub API: full_name ValveSoftware/counter-strike_regional_standings, archived false, pushed_at 2026-10-05T16:36:14Z, license null.
items.action: Use as reference data only. Note the missing licence.

items.finding: Five upcoming picks rely on the uncalibrated Valve-rating research model. Two are extreme: EAC over BOJONG at 96.1% and mellren over Privateer at 86.0%. Treat them as low-confidence.
items.measured: data/origination.json, method 'model': 9z vs Falcons 84.3% Falcons; PARIVISION vs BetBoom 73.8% BetBoom; EAC vs BOJONG 96.1% EAC; EAC vs ENCE 51.4% EAC; mellren vs Privateer 86.0% mellren.
items.action: Already labelled as uncalibrated in the methodology. Consider a visible low-confidence badge.

items.finding: COORDINATION.md is about 400 lines and holds several superseded boards. The protocol names branches 'session-<id>/<task>', but Arena fixes branches to 'arena/<id>-maltaproj3'. Many finished arena/* branches remain on origin.
items.measured: git ls-remote origin lists 7 other arena/* session branches besides arena/de176356-maltaproj3.
items.action: Integration owner archives superseded boards and notes the branch convention.

items.finding: Concurrent claim. arena-50c01ba9 claimed the day-one/contrarian review and the picks-first mobile navigation (scripts/build.py, scripts/briefing.py). This session did not start that work.
items.measured: COORDINATION.md on branch arena/50c01ba9-maltaproj3, claim at 2026-10-15T10:04Z.
items.action: Owner completes the claimed work and merges. Integration checks it.
